review_text: We waited 45 minutes for our starters and nobody told us why. The food itself was good.
Service was very slow tonight. We had to keep reminding the waiter about our order.
Long wait for a table even with a booking. The pasta was cold when it reached our table.
Lovely staff and a calm atmosphere. The biryani was fresh and tasty.
Prices are too high for the portion size but the dessert was delicious.
